card.title: Stay for the Result
card.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.
